### A Pivotal Moment in Church History
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/a-pivotal-moment-in-church-history-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-december-27-2016.html
Passage: Acts 10:28
Points:
- The conversion of Cornelius was a decisive moment in the global expansion of the early church.
- Peter was a devout Jew who naturally observed strict cultural separation from non-Jews.
- God used Peter's rooftop vision to prepare him to reach people rather than discuss dietary laws.
- God called Peter to leave his comfort zone so the gospel could reach the Gentiles.
- Peter's obedience to visit Cornelius and share Christ permanently reshaped church history.

### Day 239: Acts 10:9–28
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-239-acts-10-928.html
Passage: Acts 10:28
Points:
- God consistently dishonors prejudice, even when it is found in committed, godly believers.
- Peter had to confront inherited cultural assumptions that made him view Gentiles as unclean.
- Spiritual growth requires allowing God to pry open our minds and dismantle our biases.
- Christians must recognize distinct callings and differences without letting them cause division.
- Believers must reject spiritual elitism, remembering that everything we have is an unmerited gift of grace.
